audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text says 'don't cast Q or E into his raised Wind Wall' and early says Wind Wall blocks 'your Tides of Blood and Transfusion'. Wind Wall blocks projectiles; Vladimir's Transfusion is a non-projectile targeted drain and is not blocked — only the Tides of Blood (E) volley is. Q through Wind Wall is Vladimir's main poke tool in this lane.
audit.why: League Wiki lists Transfusion among non-projectile targeted abilities Wind Wall does not stop; the owner kit carries no projectile flag on Q while E's missiles are minion-blockable projectiles.
audit.corrected: E-only blocking stated; Q-connects-through-wall stated as the trade lever.

audit.why: Kit: W 25-17s with 4s duration, R 70/50/30s, Vlad W 28s.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Sanguine Pool like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s max, blocks projectiles for 4s — hold your E until it drops; Q still connects through it. - His R falls to 30s by rank 3 — Pool the knock-up itself, not the follow-up. - Guard your 28s Pool like a fifth summoner spell.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: His third Q knocks up and Last Breath needs an airborne target — Pool the whirlwind and both combo and R fizzle.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: A held E charge is a walking invitation — his 475-range E-Q dash combo lands before the release pays you anything.

edits.before: Q-farm and nothing else — your level 1 is among the worst mid. Give CS you can't Q safely and smile about it.
edits.after: His Steel Tempest poke and passive shield beat your worst-in-class level 1 — give CS you can't Q safely.

edits.before: Still surviving. Q on cooldown when free, pool saved for the jungler you haven't seen yet.
edits.after: Sweeping Blade pressure joins the Q poke. Q when free, pool saved for the jungler you haven't seen.

edits.before: E charges join the pattern: Q-E wave contact trades start mattering. Health is your mana — spend like an accountant.
edits.after: Level 3 Sweeping Blade all-ins through the wave out-trade your sustain. Health is your mana — spend like an accountant.

edits.before: The crimson rush timing — Q empowers every third-ish cast and the sustain war starts tilting your way.
edits.after: Crimson Rush starts tilting the sustain war, but his dash all-in still lands before your stacks pay out.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: His Shieldbow-crit spike lands first: the Q-E-R burst beats your sustain tick — play around your Pool cooldown.

edits.before: Yasuo out-trades you early: his Q Steel Tempest poke plus Wind Wall eats your Transfusion, and his E Sweeping Blade dashes through the minion wave to all-in you, so hug your caster minions, deny him easy E resets, and don't cast Q or E into his raised Wind Wall.
edits.after: Yasuo out-trades you early: Steel Tempest poke plus his passive shield eats your Transfusion, and E Sweeping Blade dashes through the wave to all-in you, so hug caster minions, deny easy E resets, and never cast Tides of Blood into a raised Wind Wall — only your E is blocked.

edits.before: Yasuo controls the first four levels: Steel Tempest poke, Wind Wall blocking your Tides of Blood and Transfusion, and Sweeping Blade dashes let him all-in through the wave before your sustain matters, so farm defensively and never feed his E resets.
edits.after: Yasuo controls the first four levels: Steel Tempest poke, Wind Wall blocking your Tides of Blood — though Transfusion connects through it — and Sweeping Blade all-ins through the wave before your sustain matters, so farm defensively and never feed his E resets.
